listenings.text: Good morning. This is London Paddington. The Heathrow Express to the airport is on platform six. The next train is at nine fifteen. The trip is fifteen minutes. Please have your ticket in your hand. Thank you for traveling with us.

Hi, Bruna, it is Emma from the Park Hotel. Thank you for your stay! Your check-out is done, and your receipt is in your email. Is your taxi here? Have a good flight home, and see you on your next trip!

extra_audio.text: Bruna checks in at the airport in São Paulo. She answers the officer in London. She gets her key at the hotel. She buys a black jacket on Oxford Street. A taxi takes her to the station.

lesson.pre_a1_modelo: This is my first trip alone. I am happy.
